name: PB&J Typhoon Pancake (Peanut Butter & Jelly Griddle Cake)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Any adult can order this beloved DCL breakfast classic: warm buttermilk pancake swirled with creamy peanut butter and seedless grape/strawberry jelly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for creamy peanut butter and seedless grape jelly on your pancake stack.
watchOuts: Verify jelly is seedless grape rather than seeded raspberry
